evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We release VidRouteBench: 16 arms from 7 open families spanning 121x in measured cost ($0.0025-$0.298 per clip), 27,110 clips (1,421 A800-hours) over 1,625 grouped prompts, a quality score frozen after calibration against human preferences (68.7% CV accuracy vs 66.2% for the best single scorer), per-clip scores on 9 identifiable quality dimensions, repeated seeds, an encrypted test split, and a sealed newest family for cold start.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: The evaluator compares a router against the best prompt-agnostic mixture of arms, not the best single arm.
